messages:
Rhea: dropped a small prototype — trying an inline-unit pill that expands to a micro-panel on hover/focus. goal: keep legends single-line in dense dashboard rows and surface units + smoothing + clip state only when asked. Matt: nice. how does the pill behave on touch? hover won't work on phones. Rhea: on touch it toggles on tap; long-press shows a contextual menu (mute/pin/inspect). for keyboard Enter/Space toggles. Sofia: microcopy proposal for the panel header: - Variant A: "Round-trip time (p95) \u2022 12.3 ms \u2022 smoothed (5m)" - Variant B: "RTT — 12.3 ms — smoothed" Prefer A for clarity. Kai: outlier handling idea: keep percentile clipping at 99th by default but render a faint dashed cap on the y-axis and show a tiny caret on the unit pill when clip active. tapping caret overlays raw spikes as a semi-transparent layer. Matt: perf note: overlay as a separate canvas layer to avoid reflow. compute clip flag server-side so UI just toggles. stable DOM keys by series_id. Sofia: accessibility: the expanded micro-panel must have aria-label and aria-describedby linking to the pill. e.g., pill button aria-controls=panel-id and the panel role=region aria-label="RTT details". ensure Escape closes the panel. Rhea: sketch: ```html
Round-trip time (p95)
12.3 ms · smoothed (5m)
``` Kai: ensure the sparkline stroke has sufficient contrast (>=3:1) and is marked aria-hidden if purely decorative. also include a textual fallback in panel for screen readers: "peak 48 ms, mean 10 ms". Matt: copy tweak: change "smoothed (5m)" -> "smoothed — 5m window" to reduce ambiguity. Sofia: keyboard flow checklist: focus lands on pill, Enter toggles panel (aria-expanded), Shift+Tab moves back, Escape closes. announce clip state when panel opens: "values clipped above 99th percentile". add automated screen-reader test. accessibility-bot: accessibility check: remember to include visible focus indicators and 44px min touch targets for interactive elements. CI will run axe checks on the preview. Rhea: action items: 1) Matt — implement overlay canvas and stable id plan. 2) Sofia — add aria examples + screen-reader test. 3) Kai — finalize clip visual (dashed cap + caret). I'll iterate the prototype and push a preview. :sparkles:
